title: Cloyster Turns Damage Into Weapons
premise: When Cloyster's hard shell is damaged, those areas swell into large, sharp spikes.
audiencePromise: See how Cloyster's protection can transform into a way to repel foes.
openLoop: Can damaging Cloyster's protection make it more dangerous?
payoff: The shell that protects Cloyster can also produce spikes used to repel foes.
engagementQuestion: Attack its shell, or leave its defense intact?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a strange discovery. Use quick, warm pacing. Stress damage, swells, and protection. Pause briefly before the spike reveal.

scenes.headline: DAMAGE BECOMES SPIKES
scenes.narration: Cloyster’s shell turns damage into sharp spikes.
scenes.caption: DAMAGE CAN BECOME SPIKES

scenes.headline: THE SHELL STAYS SHUT
scenes.narration: Cloyster fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection.
scenes.caption: THE SHELL IS ITS DEFENSE

scenes.headline: DAMAGED AREAS SWELL
scenes.narration: Then damaged areas of that very hard shell begin to swell.
scenes.caption: DAMAGE STARTS THE CHANGE

scenes.headline: SWELLING BECOMES SPIKES
scenes.narration: Those swollen areas gradually grow into large, sharp spikes.
scenes.caption: LARGE SHARP SPIKES GROW

scenes.headline: PROTECTION PUSHES BACK
scenes.narration: Cloyster shoots spikes from its shell to repel foes.
scenes.caption: THE SHELL CAN REPEL FOES

scenes.headline: ATTACK OR HOLD BACK?
scenes.narration: Attack its shell, or leave its defense intact?
scenes.caption: ATTACK THE SHELL OR HOLD BACK?
